title: SECURITY: Scope discourse-assign MessageBus broadcasts to secure topic audiences
body:
## Summary

Both patches apply `topic.secure_audience_publish_messages` to discourse-assign lifecycle broadcasts so private-topic events reach only authorized audiences.

## Patches

- **discourse-assign: Scope PM Assignment Refresh Events to Secure MessageBus Aud...** ([patch #2653](https://patch.discourse.org/patch-triage/2653))
  Discourse Assign published four private-topic assignment refresh events to MessageBus without applying the topic's secure audience, allowing nonparticipants to observe private topic activity metadata. Each publish now supplies `topic.secure_audience_publish_messages` so delivery is restricted to authorized PM participants and staff, matching core's behavior.
- **Scope discourse-assign topic reload MessageBus broadcasts to the topic's secu...** ([patch #2655](https://patch.discourse.org/patch-triage/2655))
  Prevent leakage of private/restricted topic existence and activity timing by scoping all four discourse-assign lifecycle reload broadcasts on `/topic/{id}` to the topic's `secure_audience_publish_messages`, matching core's TopicPublisher behavior. Authorized participants and groups continue to receive reload events while anonymous or unauthorized MessageBus pollers are excluded.
